messages:
From: Amy Lin <amy.lin@meridian-retail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Meridian Ops <ops@meridian-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: URGENT: Checkout traffic collapse in us-east-1 AZ1 — 30% success rate

Olga,

We started seeing a sudden throughput collapse at ~07:50 this morning for checkout traffic routed to us-east-1 AZ1. Error rate has jumped to ~65% 5xx and our successful checkouts are down ~70% vs baseline. This is affecting all tiers and is causing payment retries to stall. Our remediation team is queued but we need Redwood's assistance to stabilize — latency is spiking above 1.8s P95 and token generation timeouts are increasing.

Can you confirm whether this looks like a regional AZ issue on your side and whether a cross-region steer or instant failover is possible for our production route? We're under an active promotion window and need a plan within the next 30 minutes.

Thanks — Amy
Amy Lin
CTO, Meridian Retail
amy.lin@meridian-retail.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Lin <amy.lin@meridian-retail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 08:20:31 -0500
Subject: Re: URGENT: Checkout traffic collapse in us-east-1 AZ1 — 30% success rate

Amy —

Thank you for the alert and the log excerpt. We're seeing matching telemetry: a sharp increase in error responses from our us-east-1 AZ1 serving cluster starting 07:48. Spike appears correlated with a change in queueing behavior on the AZ1 NLBs and sustained KV cache misses for popular prefixes (payment auth paths).

Immediate next steps from our side (already kicked off):
- Engineering (Markus + David) is isolating the AZ1 worker pool and validating kernel-level metrics.
- Operations is preparing an immediate cross-region steer to us-east-2 for new connections; this is a targeted steer for the /checkout route only to minimize cold-start risk.
- Preparing an exec summary and one-time credit proposal if failover impacts session continuity.

Can you confirm whether Meridian wants full failover (drain AZ1 and move existing sessions) or a new-connection-only steer for now? New-connection steer is lower risk and faster.

I'll keep you posted every 15 minutes.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 08:28:10 -0500
Subject: Re: URGENT: Checkout traffic collapse in us-east-1 AZ1 — triage notes

Lab notes (initial):
- Observed: CPU + request queue latency on AZ1 inference pool spiked 3x at 07:48. GPU utilization didn't saturate; instead we see elevated GC/KV cache thrash and longer kernel scheduling delays which match elevated P95 timing.
- Hypothesis: sudden shift in prefix distribution caused cache churn and request amplification on a subset of model shards in AZ1. It's not a pure hardware failure.
- Impact window: 07:48 -> ongoing.

Mitigation plan (15-60m):
1) Immediate: execute new-connection-only steer for /checkout to us-east-2. This will leave existing active sessions on AZ1 to avoid session loss.
2) Short term: enable conservative prefix caching for checkout prefixes on AZ1 (reduces KV misses but may increase memory).
3) Medium term: if error rate doesn't drop within 20m, initiate controlled drain of AZ1 checkout worker pool and redirect established sessions (requires session rehydration; expect ~60s disruption for in-flight payments).

Attachments: meridian_kpi_snapshot.csv (live metrics), proposed-failover-plan.pdf

Markus
Markus Klein
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime

Please start with the new-connection steer to us-east-2 immediately. We prefer to avoid draining active sessions unless absolutely necessary. Amy

To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 08:45:02 -05:00
Subject: Exec sync & proposed comms: Meridian Retail P0 — request for CEO/CS approval

Team / Marissa —

We need an expedited exec sync and approval on a couple of customer asks: Meridian requested an immediate new-connection steer (approved by Amy) and they're sensitive to session loss; they're also asking for guidance on customer messaging and potential one-time credit given the promotion window. Proposed plan (see attached exec-summary-20261207.docx):
- Technical: execute new-connection steer now (Markus to run) + enable conservative prefix caching on AZ1. If error rate < 5% within 20m, no drain. If not, prepare controlled drain window and notify Meridian with ~60s expected disruption.
- Commercial: offer a 10% one-time credit for the promotion day if we perform a forced drain that impacts confirmed payments. Otherwise provide no credit and offer joint postmortem + SLA credit review.
- Comms: recommended customer-facing message (short): “We're routing new checkout traffic to a healthy region to restore stability; we're preserving existing sessions and working to reconcile any in-flight payments. We'll update within 30 minutes.”

Requesting Marissa (CS lead) and Vanessa (Product ops) to approve the commercial comms and the one-time credit threshold. Also copying Amy so Meridian is in the loop.

—Olga

Markus — proceed with steer and monitor. Olga — please send the short customer-facing note and cadence (every 15m).
